description: Plan a playable level from a prompt (0 credits): rooms placed in metres (entrance, combat rooms, junctions, key/lock, boss antechamber + boss room, treasure, secret room), connections, critical path, shortcuts, and gameplay spawns (player/packs/boss/rewards). Same seed → same level. Pair with gripforge_scene_kit for dressing props and gripforge_style_kit for enemies.

prompt.description: e.g. "gothic castle dungeon, 3 combat rooms, one boss, exploration pacing"

name: gripforge_level
